# befui

> Copy-paste React components (Radix + Tailwind 4 + CSS variables) with real motion, plus HRMS and marketing blocks. You own the files: add them with the CLI, then import from `@/components/ui/<name>`.

## Setup
- One time: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui init` (theme CSS, cn helper, AGENTS.md rules, .mcp.json)
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add <name> [name...]` or `add all`; blocks are `block:<name>`. It also installs npm packages and any befui files a component imports. (There is no `befui` package on npm: `npx befui` will fail, always use the `github:` form.)
- CLI blocked or GitHub unreachable? Do not retype components and never swap in another icon package. Fetch the JSON for the component (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/<name>.json, or the same `/r/<name>.json` path on the docs site), write every `files[].content` to `src/<path>`, do the same for every name in its `requires` (`icons` is the common one: r/icons.json, it holds every icon), `npm i` its `deps`, and merge `r/init.json` (cn helper, theme CSS) once.
- Exact source of any component as JSON (files, npm deps, requires, example): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/r/<name>.json (blocks: block-<name>.json). Every name below works in that URL.
- MCP: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui mcp` gives tools list_components, get_component, add_components
- Icons: our own set in `@/components/ui/icons`, e.g. `import { SearchIcon } from '@/components/ui/icons'`; no icon package needed
- Theme: CSS variables in index.css (--primary, --ring, --accent...). Dark mode = `dark` class on <html>. Use tokens (`bg-primary`, `text-muted-foreground`, `border`), never hard-coded colors.
- Full catalog with a working example per component: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RandomKid24/befui/main/public/llms-full.txt

## Rules that save a debugging round
- Wrap the app once in `<TooltipProvider>` (tooltip) and render `<Toaster />` once, then call `toast.success('Saved')` anywhere (toast).
- Sidebar, AppShell: put `SidebarProvider` above them. Dialog and Sheet are the same primitive; use `SheetContent` for a side drawer.
- Stateful inputs are controlled: pass `value` and `onChange` (or `checked` / `onCheckedChange` for checkbox and switch).
- Tables: `table` is bare parts for static layouts. `data-table` adds sort, filter, pagination, row selection (`selectable`, `bulkActions`), a column menu (`columnMenu`) and a sticky header (`maxHeight`); you pass rows and `Column[]`.
- Animated components need keyframes from index.css: run `npx github:RandomKid24/befui update` after adding (`--check` to only report).
- Fixed colors on purpose: terminal (always dark), avatar and tag-manager (per-name tints). Everything else follows theme tokens.
- Merge classes with `cn` from `@/lib/utils`. Edit copied files freely; `add <name> --force` overwrites local edits.

## Which component for what
- Dates, delivery and changes: week-strip (pick a day), day-agenda (one day as a time grid), order-tracker (delivery steps), diff-viewer (before and after text), event-calendar (month and week), countdown
- Status, ranking and reviews: uptime-bar (status page), leaderboard (ranked people), rating-breakdown (review summary), credit-card (card preview that flips, for checkout and add-card forms)
- Draw a chart: trend over time: line-chart or area-chart (stacked); compare categories: charts BarChart or stacked-bar-chart; share of whole: DonutChart or radial-bar-chart; correlation or outliers: scatter-chart; day-by-hour or cohort grid: matrix-heatmap; yearly activity: heatmap; tiny trend in a card: Sparkline; live feed: live-chart; stages: funnel-chart; scores on axes: radar-chart; parts of a budget: treemap; start-to-end bridge (profit): waterfall-chart; flow between stages: sankey-chart; mix shifting over time: stream-chart; price range per period: candlestick-chart; rank changes: bump-chart; seasonal cycle: rose-chart; KPI vs target: bullet-chart; before vs after per item: dumbbell-chart; percent of 100 as squares: waffle-chart; nested breakdown: sunburst-chart; per-row curves: ridgeline-chart; spread and outliers: box-plot-chart; flow between every pair: chord-chart; parts of a whole: pie-chart (3 to 5 slices) or half-donut-chart (short card); cyclic data like 24 hours: radial-line-chart; distribution of raw values: histogram-chart; few causes behind most of a problem: pareto-chart; two moments per item: slope-chart or dumbbell-chart; two groups back to back: butterfly-chart; many ranked items: lollipop-chart; bubbles by size: circle-pack-chart; share by size and group: marimekko-chart; dots sized by value in a grid: punch-card-chart; projection with a likely range: forecast-chart; overlap of two or three groups: venn-chart; frequent words: word-cloud. Five to eight scores as a pentagon or hexagon: radar-chart. The explanation of each chart (what it shows, how to read it, when to use or skip it) is in llms-full.txt; give it to the user when they ask what a chart means. All animate in on scroll.
- Show tabular data: table (static), data-table (sort/filter/select/paginate), permission-matrix (roles by permissions), kanban (cards in columns), heatmap, charts, line-chart, radar-chart, funnel-chart, gantt (schedule), org-chart, saved-views (table presets), audit-log (who changed what), file-manager
- Hint or explain on hover: tooltip (title, shortcut, arrow), InfoTip and TruncatedText (both exported by tooltip), popover for richer content, hover-card (rich preview that opens on hover or focus, e.g. a profile)
- Pick a value: select, combobox, radio-group, segmented, chip, switch, checkbox, slider, calendar, date-picker, time-picker, color-picker, toggle-group (several buttons can stay pressed, formatting toolbars), button-group (joined buttons)
- Type text or numbers: input, search-input, search-bar, password-input, otp-input, currency-input, number-stepper, tag-input, inline-edit, datetime-picker, image-upload, rich-text-editor (HTML), schema-form (form from a JSON-like description, wizard with steps), notification-preferences, mention-input (@ people), coupon-input, input-group (a field with prefix or suffix addons like https:// or .com)
- Confirm, ask, or show a form on top: dialog, alert-dialog (destructive), dialog's Sheet (side drawer), popover, context-menu (right click), image-viewer (lightbox), bottom-sheet (mobile)
- Loading and failure states: loader (ring/dots/bars/pulse/orbit/dual, BarLoader, LoadingOverlay), skeleton, spinner, empty-state, error-state (404/500), pull-to-refresh
- Workflows and settings: approval-flow (approver chain), onboarding-checklist, tag-manager, notification-preferences, shortcuts-dialog (press ?), permission-matrix
- Guide a new user: tour (spotlight walkthrough of the real page), onboarding-checklist, onboarding-carousel (mobile intro)
- Format numbers: format (formatCurrency, formatCompact, formatPercent, formatBytes, formatDuration, Currency); defaults to INR and en-IN
- Online shop and checkout: product-card (and Price), order-summary, coupon-input, number-stepper (quantity), rating
- Reorder or resize: sortable-list (rows), kanban (cards across columns), split-pane (resizable panels)
- Tell the user something: toast (transient), alert (inline), banner (page-wide), notification-center (inbox), cookie-consent
- Navigate: sidebar, app-shell, navbar (top bar), user-menu (avatar menu), theme-toggle (dark mode), settings-layout (side nav for settings), bottom-nav (mobile), swipe-actions (row gestures), tabs, breadcrumb, pagination, stepper, command (Ctrl K), table-of-contents, fab, navigation-menu (desktop mega menu in a top bar), menubar (File, Edit, View bar)
- Show KPIs and status: stat-card, bar-list (ranked bars), description-list (details), invoice, gauge, progress, progress-ring, number-ticker, badge, status-dot, charts (Sparkline, BarChart, DonutChart)
- Show people and activity: avatar, profile-card, activity-feed, timeline, chat, comment-thread, changelog, testimonial-card, rating, terminal (CLI output)
- Time: time-picker, analog-clock, world-clock, stopwatch, timer, countdown, relative-time
- Whole pages: see Page recipes below; all blocks are listed under Blocks

## Page recipes (start from a block, then edit it)
Add the block with `add block:<name>`; it pulls in everything it uses. Layout frames: wrap pages in `app-shell` (sidebar), or use `block:top-nav-layout` (navbar, no sidebar).
- Admin app frame (sidebar + topbar): block:admin-shell. Topbar extras: theme-toggle, user-menu, notification-center, command (Ctrl K)
- Analytics / traffic dashboard: block:analytics-dashboard (stat-card, line-chart, donut, bar-list)
- Sales or CRM dashboard: block:sales-dashboard, block:lead-pipeline, block:campaign-performance
- Online store admin: block:ecommerce-dashboard, block:checkout-page, block:invoice-page
- Project or team dashboard: block:project-overview, kanban, gantt, org-chart
- HR / people: block:hrms-overview, block:employee-directory, block:leave-approvals, block:leave-request-form
- Users, roles, API keys: block:user-management (invite dialog + table), permission-matrix, block:api-keys-page
- Account area: block:settings-page (tabs) or settings-layout (side nav), block:profile-page, block:billing-page
- Sign in / sign up / reset: block:sign-in, block:sign-up, block:reset-password
- Marketing site: block:landing-page (landing-sections: Hero, FeatureGrid, StatsStrip, Faq, CtaBanner, SiteFooter + navbar), block:pricing-page, comparison-table
- Mail or messages: block:inbox, chat, comment-thread
- Error pages: block:not-found-page or error-state (code 403, 404, 500)
- Details panel for one record: description-list inside a card, plus timeline or audit-log for history

# Components

## App shell (`app-shell`)
Sidebar, topbar and scrolling content area, plus a page header.
- Group: Layout
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add app-shell`
- Import: `import { AppShell, Topbar, AppContent, PageHeader } from '@/components/ui/app-shell'`
- Also needs: sidebar

Example:

```tsx
import { BellIcon, HomeIcon, SearchIcon, SettingsIcon, UsersIcon } from '@/components/ui/icons';
import { AppContent, AppShell, PageHeader, Topbar } from '@/components/ui/app-shell';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Kbd } from '@/components/ui/kbd';
import { Sidebar, SidebarContent, SidebarHeader, SidebarItem } from '@/components/ui/sidebar';

/** Minimal frame. See the Admin shell block for a full one. */
export default function AppShellDemo() {
  return (
    <div className="h-[420px] overflow-hidden rounded-xl border text-left">
      <AppShell className="h-full" sidebar={
        <Sidebar>
          <SidebarHeader><span className="text-sm font-semibold">My app</span></SidebarHeader>
          <SidebarContent>
            <SidebarItem icon={<HomeIcon />} label="Home" active />
            <SidebarItem icon={<UsersIcon />} label="Team" />
            <SidebarItem icon={<SettingsIcon />} label="Settings" />
          </SidebarContent>
        </Sidebar>
      }>
        <Topbar>
          <button className="ml-2 hidden h-8 w-56 items-center gap-2 rounded-md border bg-muted/60 px-2.5 text-[13px] text-muted-foreground sm:flex"><SearchIcon className="size-3.5" /> Search <Kbd className="ml-auto">/</Kbd></button>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon-sm" className="ml-auto" aria-label="Notifications"><BellIcon /></Button>
        </Topbar>
        <AppContent>
          <PageHeader title="Home" description="Content scrolls here, the sidebar and topbar stay put." actions={<Button size="sm">New</Button>} />
          <Card className="p-5 text-[13px] text-muted-foreground">Your page goes here.</Card>
        </AppContent>
      </AppShell>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Landing sections (`landing-sections`)
Marketing page parts: Hero, LogoStrip, FeatureGrid, StatsStrip, Faq, CtaBanner and SiteFooter. Stack them with a Navbar.
- Group: Layout
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add landing-sections`
- Import: `import { Hero, FeatureGrid, LogoStrip, StatsStrip, Faq, CtaBanner, SiteFooter } from '@/components/ui/landing-sections'`
- Also needs: accordion

Example:

```tsx
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { BarChartIcon, LockIcon, ZapIcon } from '@/components/ui/icons';
import { CtaBanner, FeatureGrid, Hero, StatsStrip } from '@/components/ui/landing-sections';

export default function LandingSectionsDemo() {
  return (
    <div className="w-full">
      <Hero
        eyebrow="New: payroll in one click"
        title="Run your people ops without the spreadsheet"
        description="Leave, attendance and payroll for growing teams."
        actions={<><Button size="lg">Start free</Button><Button size="lg" variant="outline">Book a demo</Button></>}
        className="py-10"
      />
      <StatsStrip stats={[{ value: '4,200+', label: 'Teams' }, { value: '99.98%', label: 'Uptime' }, { value: '12 min', label: 'Setup' }, { value: '4.8/5', label: 'Rating' }]} />
      <FeatureGrid
        title="Everything in one place"
        features={[
          { icon: <ZapIcon />, title: 'Fast', description: 'Approve leave and run payroll in a couple of clicks.' },
          { icon: <BarChartIcon />, title: 'Clear reports', description: 'Headcount, cost and attendance without exports.' },
          { icon: <LockIcon />, title: 'Secure', description: 'Role-based access, audit log and SSO.' },
        ]}
      />
      <CtaBanner title="Ready to switch?" description="Import your team in minutes." actions={<Button variant="secondary" size="lg">Get started</Button>} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Settings layout (`settings-layout`)
Settings page frame: vertical section list on the left, SettingsSection rows (title and help on the left, controls on the right).
- Group: Layout
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add settings-layout`
- Import: `import { SettingsLayout, SettingsSection } from '@/components/ui/settings-layout'`

Example:

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { BellIcon, LockIcon, UserIcon } from '@/components/ui/icons';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Field } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { SettingsLayout, SettingsSection } from '@/components/ui/settings-layout';
import { Switch } from '@/components/ui/switch';

export default function SettingsLayoutDemo() {
  const [tab, setTab] = React.useState('profile');
  const [email, setEmail] = React.useState(true);
  return (
    <SettingsLayout
      className="w-full"
      value={tab}
      onChange={setTab}
      items={[
        { id: 'profile', label: 'Profile', icon: <UserIcon /> },
        { id: 'notifications', label: 'Notifications', icon: <BellIcon /> },
        { id: 'security', label: 'Security', icon: <LockIcon /> },
      ]}
    >
      {tab === 'profile' && (
        <SettingsSection title="Personal info" description="Shown to teammates.">
          <Field label="Full name"><Input defaultValue="Aarav Mehta" /></Field>
          <Field label="Email"><Input type="email" defaultValue="aarav@acme.co" /></Field>
        </SettingsSection>
      )}
      {tab === 'notifications' && (
        <SettingsSection title="Email" description="Choose what lands in your inbox.">
          <label className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 text-sm">Weekly summary <Switch checked={email} onCheckedChange={setEmail} /></label>
        </SettingsSection>
      )}
      {tab === 'security' && (
        <SettingsSection title="Password" description="Use at least 12 characters.">
          <Field label="New password"><Input type="password" /></Field>
        </SettingsSection>
      )}
    </SettingsLayout>
  );
}
```

## Sidebar (`sidebar`)
Collapsible nav with groups, nested links and badges. Icon rail on desktop, slide-over on mobile.
- Group: Layout
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add sidebar`
- Import: `import { useSidebar, SidebarProvider, SidebarTrigger, Sidebar, SidebarHeader, SidebarContent, SidebarFooter, SidebarGroup, SidebarItem } from '@/components/ui/sidebar'`
- Also needs: dialog, icons, tooltip

Example:

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { BarChartIcon, CalendarIcon, InboxIcon, LayoutDashboardIcon, MegaphoneIcon, SettingsIcon, UsersIcon } from '@/components/ui/icons';
import { Sidebar, SidebarContent, SidebarFooter, SidebarGroup, SidebarHeader, SidebarItem, SidebarProvider, SidebarTrigger } from '@/components/ui/sidebar';
import { Avatar } from '@/components/ui/avatar';

export default function SidebarDemo() {
  const [page, setPage] = React.useState('Dashboard');
  const [sub, setSub] = React.useState('Requests');
  const go = (p: string) => () => setPage(p);
  return (
    <SidebarProvider>
      <div className="flex h-[440px] w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background text-left">
        <Sidebar>
          <SidebarHeader>
            <span className="grid size-7 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-md bg-primary text-xs font-bold text-primary-foreground">A</span>
            <span className="truncate text-sm font-semibold">Acme HR</span>
          </SidebarHeader>
          <SidebarContent>
            <SidebarGroup label="Overview">
              <SidebarItem icon={<LayoutDashboardIcon />} label="Dashboard" active={page === 'Dashboard'} onClick={go('Dashboard')} />
              <SidebarItem icon={<InboxIcon />} label="Inbox" badge="3" active={page === 'Inbox'} onClick={go('Inbox')} />
            </SidebarGroup>
            <SidebarGroup label="People">
              <SidebarItem icon={<UsersIcon />} label="Employees" active={page === 'Employees'} onClick={go('Employees')} />
              <SidebarItem
                icon={<CalendarIcon />}
                label="Leave"
                active={page === 'Leave'}
                items={['Requests', 'Balances', 'Calendar'].map((l) => ({ label: l, active: page === 'Leave' && sub === l, onClick: () => { setPage('Leave'); setSub(l); } }))}
              />
            </SidebarGroup>
            <SidebarGroup label="Marketing">
              <SidebarItem icon={<MegaphoneIcon />} label="Campaigns" active={page === 'Campaigns'} onClick={go('Campaigns')} />
              <SidebarItem icon={<BarChartIcon />} label="Reports" active={page === 'Reports'} onClick={go('Reports')} />
            </SidebarGroup>
          </SidebarContent>
          <SidebarFooter>
            <SidebarItem icon={<SettingsIcon />} label="Settings" active={page === 'Settings'} onClick={go('Settings')} />
          </SidebarFooter>
        </Sidebar>
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
          <div className="flex h-14 items-center gap-3 border-b px-4">
            <SidebarTrigger />
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">{page}{page === 'Leave' ? ` / ${sub}` : ''}</span>
            <Avatar name="Aarav Mehta" size="xs" className="ml-auto" />
          </div>
          <p className="p-5 text-[13px] text-muted-foreground">Use the toggle to collapse the rail. Hover an icon to see its label. Below 1024px wide the sidebar becomes a slide-over.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </SidebarProvider>
  );
}
```

## Split pane (`split-pane`)
Two resizable panels with a draggable divider. Keyboard resizable. Horizontal or vertical.
- Group: Layout
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add split-pane`
- Import: `import { SplitPane } from '@/components/ui/split-pane'`

Example:

```tsx
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { SplitPane } from '@/components/ui/split-pane';

const files = ['invoice-template.tsx', 'payroll-run.tsx', 'leave-policy.md', 'org-chart.json', 'holidays-2026.csv'];

export default function SplitPaneDemo() {
  return (
    <SplitPane className="h-72 w-full max-w-2xl" defaultSize={34} min={20} max={70}>
      {[
        <ul key="a" className="p-2">
          {files.map((f, i) => <li key={f} className={`rounded-md px-2.5 py-1.5 text-[13px] ${i === 1 ? 'bg-accent font-medium' : 'text-muted-foreground'}`}>{f}</li>)}
        </ul>,
        <div key="b" className="grid gap-3 p-5 text-[13px]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2"><h3 className="text-sm font-semibold">payroll-run.tsx</h3><Badge variant="success" dot>Saved</Badge></div>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">Drag the divider, or focus it and use the arrow keys. Shift moves in bigger steps; Home and End jump to the limits.</p>
          <pre className="rounded-lg bg-muted p-3 font-mono text-xs">{'export function runPayroll(month: string) {\n  return employees.map(pay);\n}'}</pre>
        </div>,
      ]}
    </SplitPane>
  );
}
```

## Bottom navigation (`bottom-nav`)
Mobile tab bar with icons, labels, an active pill and count badges.
- Group: Navigation
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add bottom-nav`
- Import: `import { BottomNav } from '@/components/ui/bottom-nav'`

Example:

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { BellIcon, HomeIcon, SearchIcon, UserIcon } from '@/components/ui/icons';
import { BottomNav } from '@/components/ui/bottom-nav';

export default function BottomNavDemo() {
  const [tab, setTab] = React.useState('home');
  return (
    <div className="grid h-64 w-72 grid-rows-[1fr_auto] overflow-hidden rounded-[1.75rem] border-4 border-foreground/80 bg-background">
      <div className="grid place-items-center text-sm font-medium capitalize text-muted-foreground">{tab}</div>
      <BottomNav
        value={tab}
        onValueChange={setTab}
        items={[
          { id: 'home', label: 'Home', icon: <HomeIcon /> },
          { id: 'search', label: 'Search', icon: <SearchIcon /> },
          { id: 'alerts', label: 'Alerts', icon: <BellIcon />, badge: 3 },
          { id: 'profile', label: 'Profile', icon: <UserIcon /> },
        ]}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Breadcrumb (`breadcrumb`)
Trail of parent pages.
- Group: Navigation
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add breadcrumb`
- Import: `import { Breadcrumb } from '@/components/ui/breadcrumb'`
- Also needs: icons

Example:

```tsx
import { Breadcrumb } from '@/components/ui/breadcrumb';

export default function BreadcrumbDemo() {
  return <Breadcrumb items={[{ label: 'People', href: '#' }, { label: 'Employees', href: '#' }, { label: 'Aarav Mehta' }]} />;
}
```

## Menubar (`menubar`)
Desktop-app style bar of menus (File, Edit, View) with shortcuts and checkable items.
- Group: Navigation
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add menubar`
- Import: `import { MenubarMenu, Menubar, MenubarTrigger, MenubarContent, MenubarItem, MenubarCheckboxItem, MenubarSeparator, MenubarShortcut } from '@/components/ui/menubar'`
- Also needs: icons
- npm packages: @radix-ui/react-menubar

Example:

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Menubar, MenubarCheckboxItem, MenubarContent, MenubarItem, MenubarMenu, MenubarSeparator, MenubarShortcut, MenubarTrigger } from '@/components/ui/menubar';

export default function MenubarDemo() {
  const [grid, setGrid] = React.useState(true);
  const [autosave, setAutosave] = React.useState(false);
  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-64 w-full justify-center">
      <Menubar>
        <MenubarMenu>
          <MenubarTrigger>File</MenubarTrigger>
          <MenubarContent>
            <MenubarItem>New file <MenubarShortcut>⌘N</MenubarShortcut></MenubarItem>
            <MenubarItem>Open <MenubarShortcut>⌘O</MenubarShortcut></MenubarItem>
            <MenubarSeparator />
            <MenubarCheckboxItem checked={autosave} onCheckedChange={setAutosave}>Autosave</MenubarCheckboxItem>
            <MenubarSeparator />
            <MenubarItem destructive>Delete project</MenubarItem>
          </MenubarContent>
        </MenubarMenu>
        <MenubarMenu>
          <MenubarTrigger>Edit</MenubarTrigger>
          <MenubarContent>
            <MenubarItem>Undo <MenubarShortcut>⌘Z</MenubarShortcut></MenubarItem>
            <MenubarItem>Redo <MenubarShortcut>⇧⌘Z</MenubarShortcut></MenubarItem>
          </MenubarContent>
        </MenubarMenu>
        <MenubarMenu>
          <MenubarTrigger>View</MenubarTrigger>
          <MenubarContent>
            <MenubarCheckboxItem checked={grid} onCheckedChange={setGrid}>Show grid</MenubarCheckboxItem>
            <MenubarItem>Zoom in <MenubarShortcut>⌘+</MenubarShortcut></MenubarItem>
          </MenubarContent>
        </MenubarMenu>
      </Menubar>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Navigation menu (`navigation-menu`)
Desktop top-bar menu whose items open mega-menu panels, with keyboard and focus handled.
- Group: Navigation
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add navigation-menu`
- Import: `import { NavigationMenu, NavigationMenuList, NavigationMenuItem, NavigationMenuTrigger, NavigationMenuContent, NavigationMenuLink, navigationMenuTriggerStyle } from '@/components/ui/navigation-menu'`
- Also needs: icons
- npm packages: @radix-ui/react-navigation-menu

Example:

```tsx
import { NavigationMenu, NavigationMenuContent, NavigationMenuItem, NavigationMenuLink, NavigationMenuList, NavigationMenuTrigger, navigationMenuTriggerStyle } from '@/components/ui/navigation-menu';

const products = [
  { title: 'Analytics', text: 'Traffic, funnels and reports in one place.' },
  { title: 'Automations', text: 'Run steps when something changes.' },
  { title: 'Integrations', text: 'Connect the tools your team already uses.' },
];

export default function NavigationMenuDemo() {
  return (
    <div className="min-h-72 w-full">
      <div className="flex justify-center">
        <NavigationMenu>
          <NavigationMenuList>
            <NavigationMenuItem>
              <NavigationMenuTrigger>Products</NavigationMenuTrigger>
              <NavigationMenuContent>
                <ul className="grid w-80 gap-1">
                  {products.map((p) => (
                    <li key={p.title}>
                      <NavigationMenuLink href={`#${p.title.toLowerCase()}`}>
                        <span className="block font-medium">{p.title}</span>
                        <span className="block text-[13px] text-muted-foreground">{p.text}</span>
                      </NavigationMenuLink>
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
              </NavigationMenuContent>
            </NavigationMenuItem>
            <NavigationMenuItem>
              <NavigationMenuTrigger>Resources</NavigationMenuTrigger>
              <NavigationMenuContent>
                <ul className="grid w-64 gap-1">
                  <li><NavigationMenuLink href="#docs">Documentation</NavigationMenuLink></li>
                  <li><NavigationMenuLink href="#guides">Guides</NavigationMenuLink></li>
                  <li><NavigationMenuLink href="#changelog">Changelog</NavigationMenuLink></li>
                </ul>
              </NavigationMenuContent>
            </NavigationMenuItem>
            <NavigationMenuItem>
              <NavigationMenuLink href="#pricing" className={navigationMenuTriggerStyle}>Pricing</NavigationMenuLink>
            </NavigationMenuItem>
          </NavigationMenuList>
        </NavigationMenu>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Stepper (`stepper`)
Horizontal steps for multi-step forms and onboarding.
- Group: Navigation
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add stepper`
- Import: `import { Stepper } from '@/components/ui/stepper'`
- Also needs: icons

Example:

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Stepper } from '@/components/ui/stepper';

const steps = [{ title: 'Details', description: 'Basics' }, { title: 'Role', description: 'Team & level' }, { title: 'Documents' }, { title: 'Review' }];

export default function StepperDemo() {
  const [current, setCurrent] = React.useState(1);
  return (
    <div className="grid w-full max-w-xl gap-6">
      <Stepper steps={steps} current={current} />
      <div className="flex gap-2">
        <Button size="sm" variant="outline" disabled={current === 0} onClick={() => setCurrent((c) => c - 1)}>Back</Button>
        <Button size="sm" disabled={current === steps.length} onClick={() => setCurrent((c) => c + 1)}>Next</Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
export default function TableOfContentsDemo() {

    <div className="grid w-full max-w-md gap-6 sm:grid-cols-[1fr_10rem]">
      <div className="text-[13px] text-muted-foreground">

      </div>
      <TableOfContents items={[{ id: 'toc-Overview', label: 'Overview' }, { id: 'toc-Install', label: 'Install' }, { id: 'toc-Usage', label: 'Usage' }, { id: 'toc-Props', label: 'Props', level: 2 }]} />
```

```tsx
        </TabsList>
        <TabsContent value="a" className="text-[13px] text-muted-foreground">Pill tabs, good for toggling a view.</TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="b" className="text-[13px] text-muted-foreground">Monthly view.</TabsContent>
```

## Calendar (`calendar`)
Month grid for one day or a range. Arrow keys, Page Up/Down, Home and End work.
- Group: Inputs
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add calendar`
- Import: `import { startOfDay, addDays, addMonths, isSameDay, Calendar } from '@/components/ui/calendar'`
- Also needs: icons

Example:

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Calendar, type DateRange, addDays, startOfDay } from '@/components/ui/calendar';

export default function CalendarDemo() {
  const [day, setDay] = React.useState<Date | undefined>(new Date());
  const [range, setRange] = React.useState<DateRange>();
  const today = startOfDay(new Date());
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-center gap-6">
      <div className="rounded-xl border bg-card p-3">
        <Calendar selected={day} onSelect={setDay} />
      </div>
      <div className="rounded-xl border bg-card p-3">
        <Calendar mode="range" selected={range} onSelect={setRange} weekStartsOn={1} disabled={(d) => d < addDays(today, -1)} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Checkbox (`checkbox`)
Checked, unchecked and indeterminate. Works for select-all rows.
- Group: Inputs
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add checkbox`
- Import: `import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox'`
- Also needs: icons
- npm packages: @radix-ui/react-checkbox

Example:

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox';
import { Label } from '@/components/ui/label';

export default function CheckboxDemo() {
  const [items, setItems] = React.useState({ email: true, sms: false, push: false });
  const all = Object.values(items).every(Boolean);
  const some = Object.values(items).some(Boolean);
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-3">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
        <Checkbox
          id="all"
          checked={all ? true : some ? 'indeterminate' : false}
          onCheckedChange={(v) => setItems({ email: !!v, sms: !!v, push: !!v })}
        />
        <Label htmlFor="all" className="font-semibold">Notify me by</Label>
      </div>
      {(Object.keys(items) as (keyof typeof items)[]).map((k) => (
        <div key={k} className="ml-6 flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <Checkbox id={k} checked={items[k]} onCheckedChange={(v) => setItems({ ...items, [k]: !!v })} />
          <Label htmlFor={k} className="font-normal capitalize">{k}</Label>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Combobox (`combobox`)
Searchable select, single or multiple, with descriptions under each option.
- Group: Inputs
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add combobox`
- Import: `import { Combobox, MultiCombobox } from '@/components/ui/combobox'`
- Also needs: badge, command, icons, popover

Example:

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Combobox, MultiCombobox, type ComboboxOption } from '@/components/ui/combobox';
import { Field } from '@/components/ui/label';

const people: ComboboxOption[] = [
  { value: 'aarav', label: 'Aarav Mehta', description: 'Engineering Manager' },
  { value: 'diya', label: 'Diya Rao', description: 'Product Designer' },
  { value: 'kabir', label: 'Kabir Shah', description: 'Account Executive' },
  { value: 'meera', label: 'Meera Iyer', description: 'HR Business Partner' },
  { value: 'rohan', label: 'Rohan Das', description: 'Backend Engineer' },
  { value: 'isha', label: 'Isha Nair', description: 'Marketing Lead' },
];

export default function ComboboxDemo() {
  const [approver, setApprover] = React.useState<string>();
  const [watchers, setWatchers] = React.useState<string[]>(['diya']);
  return (
    <div className="grid w-full max-w-xs gap-4">
      <Field label="Approver" htmlFor="appr">
        <Combobox id="appr" options={people} value={approver} onValueChange={setApprover} placeholder="Choose a person" searchPlaceholder="Search people..." />
      </Field>
      <Field label="Notify" htmlFor="notify" hint="Pick as many as you like.">
        <MultiCombobox id="notify" options={people} value={watchers} onValueChange={setWatchers} placeholder="Add people" />
      </Field>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Coupon input (`coupon-input`)
Promo code field with async validation, an error message and a removable applied chip.
- Group: Inputs
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add coupon-input`
- Import: `import { CouponInput } from '@/components/ui/coupon-input'`
- Also needs: button, icons, input

Example:

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { CouponInput } from '@/components/ui/coupon-input';

const codes: Record<string, string> = { WELCOME10: 'You save 10% on this order', FESTIVE250: 'You save ₹250' };

export default function CouponInputDemo() {
  const [applied, setApplied] = React.useState<string>();
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-xs">
      <CouponInput
        applied={applied}
        hint={applied && codes[applied]}
        onApply={async (c) => { await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600)); if (!codes[c]) return false; setApplied(c); return true; }}
        onRemove={() => setApplied(undefined)}
      />
      {!applied && <p className="mt-2 px-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Try WELCOME10 or FESTIVE250.</p>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Date picker (`date-picker`)
Date and date range fields that open a calendar. The range picker has optional quick presets (Last 7 days, This month...) and a day count. Closes on pick.
- Group: Inputs
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add date-picker`
- Import: `import { formatDate, DatePicker, defaultRangePresets, DateRangePicker } from '@/components/ui/date-picker'`
- Also needs: calendar, icons, popover

Example:

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { DatePicker, DateRangePicker } from '@/components/ui/date-picker';
import type { DateRange } from '@/components/ui/calendar';
import { Field } from '@/components/ui/label';
import { addDays, startOfDay } from '@/components/ui/calendar';

export default function DatePickerDemo() {
  const [joined, setJoined] = React.useState<Date>();
  const [leave, setLeave] = React.useState<DateRange>();
  const [period, setPeriod] = React.useState<DateRange>();
  const today = startOfDay(new Date());
  return (
    <div className="grid w-full max-w-sm gap-4">
      <Field label="Joining date" htmlFor="join" hint="Clear it with the x.">
        <DatePicker id="join" value={joined} onChange={setJoined} clearable />
      </Field>
      <Field label="Leave dates" htmlFor="leave" hint="Past dates are disabled.">
        <DateRangePicker id="leave" value={leave} onChange={setLeave} disabledDays={(d) => d < addDays(today, 0)} clearable />
      </Field>
      <Field label="Report period" htmlFor="period" hint="Quick ranges on the left.">
        <DateRangePicker id="period" value={period} onChange={setPeriod} presets clearable />
      </Field>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## File uploader (`file-uploader`)
Multi-file drop area with a progress bar per file, cancel, retry and a concurrency limit. You supply the upload function.
- Group: Inputs
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add file-uploader`
- Import: `import { FileUploader } from '@/components/ui/file-uploader'`
- Also needs: icons, progress

Example:

```tsx
import { FileUploader } from '@/components/ui/file-uploader';

/** Fake upload: ticks to 100% over a couple of seconds. Files named "fail" error out so you can try Retry. */
const fakeUpload = (file: File, onProgress: (p: number) => void, signal: AbortSignal) =>
  new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    let p = 0;
    const id = setInterval(() => {
      p += 8 + Math.random() * 12;
      if (file.name.toLowerCase().includes('fail') && p > 55) { clearInterval(id); return reject(new Error('Server rejected the file.')); }
      onProgress(Math.min(p, 100));
      if (p >= 100) { clearInterval(id); resolve(); }
    }, 250);
    signal.addEventListener('abort', () => { clearInterval(id); reject(new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError')); });
  });

export default function FileUploaderDemo() {
  return <FileUploader className="w-full max-w-md" upload={fakeUpload} />;
}
```

## OTP input (`otp-input`)

Example:

```tsx

  const [v, setV] = React.useState('');
  const [bad, setBad] = React.useState(false);
  return (
    <div className="grid justify-items-center gap-3">
      <OtpInput
        value={v}
        invalid={bad}
        onChange={(x) => { setV(x); setBad(false); }}
        onComplete={(x) => (x === '123456' ? toast.success('Verified') : (setBad(true), setTimeout(() => setV(''), 500)))}
      />
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Try 123456, or paste any code.</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Schema form (`schema-form`)
Build a form from a description: text, email, number, date, select, textarea and checkbox fields, validation, and optional multi-step wizard with a stepper.
- Group: Inputs
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add schema-form`
- Import: `import { SchemaForm } from '@/components/ui/schema-form'`
- Also needs: button, checkbox, input, label, select, stepper

Example:

```tsx
import { SchemaForm, type FormStep } from '@/components/ui/schema-form';
import { toast } from '@/components/ui/toast';

const steps: FormStep[] = [
  {
    title: 'Personal',
    description: 'Basic details for the employee record.',
    fields: [
      { name: 'first', label: 'First name', required: true, half: true },
      { name: 'last', label: 'Last name', required: true, half: true },
      { name: 'email', label: 'Work email', type: 'email', required: true, placeholder: 'name@company.com' },
      { name: 'phone', label: 'Phone', type: 'tel', half: true, validate: (v) => (v && !/^\d{10}$/.test(String(v)) ? 'Use 10 digits.' : undefined) },
      { name: 'dob', label: 'Date of birth', type: 'date', half: true },
    ],
  },
  {
    title: 'Job',
    description: 'Where they sit and what they do.',
    fields: [
      { name: 'dept', label: 'Department', type: 'select', required: true, half: true, options: [{ value: 'eng', label: 'Engineering' }, { value: 'design', label: 'Design' }, { value: 'sales', label: 'Sales' }] },
      { name: 'salary', label: 'Annual salary (₹)', type: 'number', half: true },
      { name: 'notes', label: 'Notes for HR', type: 'textarea', hint: 'Visible to the People team only.' },
    ],
  },
  { title: 'Confirm', fields: [{ name: 'ok', label: 'I confirm these details are correct', type: 'checkbox', required: true }] },
];

export default function SchemaFormDemo() {
  return <SchemaForm steps={steps} submitLabel="Create employee" onSubmit={async (v) => { await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); toast.success('Employee created', `${v.first} ${v.last}`); }} />;
}
```

## Segmented control (`segmented`)
Pick one of a few views or ranges. Smaller than tabs.
- Group: Inputs
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add segmented`
- Import: `import { Segmented } from '@/components/ui/segmented'`
- npm packages: @radix-ui/react-toggle-group

Example:

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { LayoutGridIcon, ListIcon } from '@/components/ui/icons';
import { Segmented } from '@/components/ui/segmented';

export default function SegmentedDemo() {
  const [range, setRange] = React.useState('30d');
  const [view, setView] = React.useState('list');
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-4">
      <Segmented value={range} onValueChange={setRange} options={[{ value: '7d', label: '7 days' }, { value: '30d', label: '30 days' }, { value: '90d', label: '90 days' }]} />
      <Segmented value={view} onValueChange={setView} options={[{ value: 'list', label: <><ListIcon /> List</> }, { value: 'grid', label: <><LayoutGridIcon /> Grid</> }]} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Toggle (`toggle`)
Two-state button for favourite, bold or mute. Announces its state to screen readers.
- Group: Inputs
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add toggle`
- Import: `import { Toggle } from '@/components/ui/toggle'`

Example:

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { BookmarkIcon, HeartIcon, StarIcon } from '@/components/ui/icons';
import { Toggle } from '@/components/ui/toggle';

export default function ToggleDemo() {
  const [a, setA] = React.useState(true);
  const [b, setB] = React.useState(false);
  const [c, setC] = React.useState(false);
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
      <Toggle pressed={a} onPressedChange={setA} size="icon" aria-label="Favourite"><HeartIcon className={a ? 'fill-current' : ''} /></Toggle>
      <Toggle variant="outline" pressed={b} onPressedChange={setB} size="icon" aria-label="Star"><StarIcon className={b ? 'fill-current' : ''} /></Toggle>
      <Toggle variant="outline" pressed={c} onPressedChange={setC}><BookmarkIcon className={c ? 'fill-current' : ''} /> Save</Toggle>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Toggle group (`toggle-group`)
A row of toggles where one or several can be pressed, for formatting toolbars.
- Group: Inputs
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add toggle-group`
- Import: `import { ToggleGroup, ToggleGroupItem } from '@/components/ui/toggle-group'`
- npm packages: @radix-ui/react-toggle-group

Example:

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { AlignCenterIcon, AlignLeftIcon, AlignRightIcon, BoldIcon, ItalicIcon, UnderlineIcon } from '@/components/ui/icons';
import { ToggleGroup, ToggleGroupItem } from '@/components/ui/toggle-group';

export default function ToggleGroupDemo() {
  const [format, setFormat] = React.useState<string[]>(['bold']);
  const [align, setAlign] = React.useState('left');
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-6">
      <ToggleGroup type="multiple" variant="outline" size="icon" value={format} onValueChange={setFormat} aria-label="Text formatting">
        <ToggleGroupItem value="bold" aria-label="Bold"><BoldIcon /></ToggleGroupItem>
        <ToggleGroupItem value="italic" aria-label="Italic"><ItalicIcon /></ToggleGroupItem>
        <ToggleGroupItem value="underline" aria-label="Underline"><UnderlineIcon /></ToggleGroupItem>
      </ToggleGroup>
      <ToggleGroup type="single" size="icon" value={align} onValueChange={(v) => v && setAlign(v)} aria-label="Alignment">
        <ToggleGroupItem value="left" aria-label="Align left"><AlignLeftIcon /></ToggleGroupItem>
        <ToggleGroupItem value="center" aria-label="Align center"><AlignCenterIcon /></ToggleGroupItem>
        <ToggleGroupItem value="right" aria-label="Align right"><AlignRightIcon /></ToggleGroupItem>
      </ToggleGroup>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Approval flow (`approval-flow`)
Chain of approvers with decisions, comments and times. The current approver gets Approve and Reject buttons.
- Group: Display
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add approval-flow`
- Import: `import { ApprovalFlow } from '@/components/ui/approval-flow'`
- Also needs: avatar, button, icons

Example:

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { ApprovalFlow, type ApprovalStep } from '@/components/ui/approval-flow';
import { toast } from '@/components/ui/toast';

export default function ApprovalFlowDemo() {
  const [steps, setSteps] = React.useState<ApprovalStep[]>([
    { id: '1', approver: 'Rohan Das', role: 'Team lead', status: 'approved', comment: 'Looks fine, within the team budget.', at: '07 Oct' },
    { id: '2', approver: 'Meera Iyer', role: 'Finance', status: 'pending' },
    { id: '3', approver: 'Aarav Mehta', role: 'CTO', status: 'waiting' },
  ]);
  const decide = (id: string, d: 'approved' | 'rejected', comment: string) => {
    setSteps((l) => l.map((s, i) => {
      if (s.id === id) return { ...s, status: d, comment: comment || undefined, at: 'Just now' };
      if (d === 'approved' && l[i - 1]?.id === id) return { ...s, status: 'pending' };
      return s;
    }));
    toast[d === 'approved' ? 'success' : 'info'](d === 'approved' ? 'Approved' : 'Rejected');
  };
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-md rounded-xl border bg-card p-5">
      <p className="mb-4 text-sm font-semibold">Laptop purchase · ₹1,45,000</p>
      <ApprovalFlow steps={steps} onDecide={decide} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Chat (`chat`)
Message bubbles with avatars, timestamps, a typing indicator and a composer. Enter sends.
- Group: Display
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add chat`
- Import: `import { Chat } from '@/components/ui/chat'`
- Also needs: avatar, icons

Example:

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Chat, type ChatMessage } from '@/components/ui/chat';

const m = (id: string, from: string, text: string, ago: number): ChatMessage => ({ id, from, text, at: Date.now() - ago * 60000 });

export default function ChatDemo() {
  const [messages, setMessages] = React.useState<ChatMessage[]>([
    m('1', 'Diya Rao', 'Hey! Did the offer letter go out to Kabir?', 14),
    m('2', 'Diya Rao', 'He is asking about the joining date.', 13),
    m('3', 'You', 'Sent it this morning. Joining is 3 Nov.', 9),
    m('4', 'Diya Rao', 'Perfect, I will update the onboarding board.', 8),
  ]);
  const [typing, setTyping] = React.useState<string>();
  const send = (text: string) => {
    setMessages((l) => [...l, { id: String(Date.now()), from: 'You', text, at: Date.now() }]);
    setTyping('Diya Rao');
    setTimeout(() => {
      setTyping(undefined);
      setMessages((l) => [...l, { id: String(Date.now()), from: 'Diya Rao', text: 'Got it, thanks!', at: Date.now() }]);
    }, 1500);
  };
  return <Chat me="You" messages={messages} onSend={send} typing={typing} />;
}
```

## Comment thread (`comment-thread`)
Nested comments with inline reply boxes, three levels deep.
- Group: Display
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add comment-thread`
- Import: `import { CommentThread } from '@/components/ui/comment-thread'`
- Also needs: avatar, button, input

Example:

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { CommentThread, type Comment } from '@/components/ui/comment-thread';

const add = (list: Comment[], parent: string, c: Comment): Comment[] =>
  list.map((x) => (x.id === parent ? { ...x, replies: [...(x.replies ?? []), c] } : { ...x, replies: x.replies && add(x.replies, parent, c) }));

export default function CommentThreadDemo() {
  const [comments, setComments] = React.useState<Comment[]>([
    { id: '1', author: 'Meera Shah', time: '2h ago', body: 'Can we move the review to Thursday?', replies: [
      { id: '2', author: 'Rohan Iyer', time: '1h ago', body: 'Thursday works for me.' },
    ] },
    { id: '3', author: 'Kabir Anand', time: '30m ago', body: 'Added the updated budget sheet.' },
  ]);
  return <CommentThread className="w-full max-w-lg" comments={comments} onReply={(p, text) => setComments((c) => add(c, p, { id: crypto.randomUUID(), author: 'You', time: 'just now', body: text }))} />;
}
```

## Credit card (`credit-card`)
Payment card preview that flips in 3D to show the CVV. Formats as the user types, guesses Visa, Mastercard, AmEx or RuPay, and can mask the number.
- Group: Display
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add credit-card`
- Import: `import { CreditCard } from '@/components/ui/credit-card'`

Example:

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { CreditCard } from '@/components/ui/credit-card';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';

export default function CreditCardDemo() {
  const [f, setF] = React.useState({ number: '4111 1111 1111 1111', name: 'Aarav Mehta', expiry: '08/28', cvv: '' });
  const [back, setBack] = React.useState(false);
  const set = (k: keyof typeof f) => (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => setF({ ...f, [k]: e.target.value });
  return (
    <div className="grid justify-items-center gap-5">
      <CreditCard {...f} flipped={back} onFlip={setBack} />
      <div className="grid w-80 max-w-full grid-cols-2 gap-2">
        <Input className="col-span-2" aria-label="Card number" inputMode="numeric" maxLength={19} value={f.number} onChange={set('number')} onFocus={() => setBack(false)} />
        <Input className="col-span-2" aria-label="Name" value={f.name} onChange={set('name')} onFocus={() => setBack(false)} />
        <Input aria-label="Expiry" placeholder="MM/YY" maxLength={5} value={f.expiry} onChange={set('expiry')} onFocus={() => setBack(false)} />
        <Input aria-label="CVV" placeholder="CVV" inputMode="numeric" maxLength={4} value={f.cvv} onChange={set('cvv')} onFocus={() => setBack(true)} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx

const rows: [string, string][] = [
  ['formatCurrency(1250000)', formatCurrency(1250000)],
  ['formatCurrency(1250000, { compact: true })', formatCurrency(1250000, { compact: true })],
  ['formatCurrency(4999.5, { currency: "USD", locale: "en-US" })', formatCurrency(4999.5, { currency: 'USD', locale: 'en-US' })],
  ['formatCompact(48200)', formatCompact(48200)],
  ['formatPercent(0.1234)', formatPercent(0.1234)],
  ['formatBytes(1536000)', formatBytes(1536000)],
  ['formatDuration(3725)', formatDuration(3725)],
];

export default function FormatDemo() {
  return (
    <div className="grid w-full max-w-xl gap-4">
      <dl className="grid gap-1.5 rounded-xl border bg-card p-4 font-mono text-xs">
        {rows.map(([call, out]) => <div key={call} className="flex justify-between gap-4"><dt className="truncate text-muted-foreground">{call}</dt><dd className="shrink-0 font-semibold text-foreground">{out}</dd></div>)}
      </dl>
      <p className="flex gap-4 text-sm">Net change: <Currency value={42500} signed /> <Currency value={-18200} signed /></p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Onboarding checklist (`onboarding-checklist`)
Getting-started card with a progress bar, tick-off items, short help text and actions. Collapsible.
- Group: Display
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add onboarding-checklist`
- Import: `import { OnboardingChecklist } from '@/components/ui/onboarding-checklist'`
- Also needs: icons, progress

Example:

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { OnboardingChecklist, type ChecklistItem } from '@/components/ui/onboarding-checklist';

export default function OnboardingChecklistDemo() {
  const [items, setItems] = React.useState<ChecklistItem[]>([
    { id: 'profile', title: 'Complete your profile', done: true },
    { id: 'team', title: 'Invite your team', description: 'Add colleagues by email so they can see shared reports.', done: false, action: <Button size="xs">Invite people</Button> },
    { id: 'data', title: 'Import employees', description: 'Upload a CSV or connect your payroll tool.', done: false, action: <Button size="xs" variant="outline">Upload CSV</Button> },
    { id: 'leave', title: 'Set up leave policies', done: false },
  ]);
  return <OnboardingChecklist items={items} onToggle={(id, done) => setItems((l) => l.map((i) => (i.id === id ? { ...i, done } : i)))} />;
}
```

## Order summary (`order-summary`)
Cart lines with subtotal, discount, shipping, tax and total computed for you. Slots for a coupon field and a checkout button.
- Group: Display
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add order-summary`
- Import: `import { OrderSummary } from '@/components/ui/order-summary'`

Example:

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { CouponInput } from '@/components/ui/coupon-input';
import { OrderSummary, type OrderLine } from '@/components/ui/order-summary';

const lines: OrderLine[] = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Wireless keyboard', detail: 'Graphite · UK layout', qty: 1, price: 3499 },
  { id: '2', name: 'Noise-cancelling headphones', detail: 'Midnight blue', qty: 2, price: 8999 },
  { id: '3', name: 'Standing desk mat', qty: 1, price: 1299 },
];

export default function OrderSummaryDemo() {
  const [code, setCode] = React.useState<string>();
  return (
    <OrderSummary
      lines={lines}
      discount={code ? 250 : 0}
      shipping={0}
      taxRate={0.18}
      action={<Button className="w-full" size="lg">Place order</Button>}
    >
      <CouponInput applied={code} hint={code && 'You save ₹250'} onApply={(c) => { const ok = c === 'FESTIVE250'; if (ok) setCode(c); return ok; }} onRemove={() => setCode(undefined)} />
    </OrderSummary>
  );
}
```

```tsx
  return (
    <div className="grid justify-items-center gap-6">

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-stretch justify-center gap-4">
        <PricingCard name="Starter" description="For teams up to 25." price={y ? 239 : 299} features={['Leave and attendance', 'Employee directory', 'Email support']} />
        <PricingCard highlighted name="Growth" description="Payroll included." price={y ? 399 : 499} features={['Everything in Starter', 'Payroll and payslips', 'Approvals workflow', 'Priority support']} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Product card (`product-card`)
Product tile with image, rating, price with strike-through, discount tag, wishlist heart and Add button. Also exports Price.
- Group: Display
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add product-card`
- Import: `import { Price, ProductCard } from '@/components/ui/product-card'`
- Also needs: button, icons, rating

Example:

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Price, ProductCard } from '@/components/ui/product-card';
import { toast } from '@/components/ui/toast';

const art = (a: string, b: string, glyph: string) =>
  `data:image/svg+xml;utf8,${encodeURIComponent(`<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 240"><rect width="240" height="240" fill="${a}"/><circle cx="120" cy="120" r="62" fill="${b}"/><text x="120" y="136" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="44" text-anchor="middle" fill="white">${glyph}</text></svg>`)}`;

const products = [
  { id: 'p1', name: 'Wireless keyboard', category: 'Accessories', price: 3499, compareAt: 4999, rating: 4.6, reviews: 128, image: art('#e0e7ff', '#4f46e5', 'K') },
  { id: 'p2', name: 'Noise-cancelling headphones', category: 'Audio', price: 8999, rating: 4.8, reviews: 412, image: art('#fce7f3', '#db2777', 'H') },
  { id: 'p3', name: 'Standing desk mat', category: 'Office', price: 1299, compareAt: 1599, rating: 4.2, reviews: 57, image: art('#dcfce7', '#16a34a', 'M') },
];

export default function ProductCardDemo() {
  const [liked, setLiked] = React.useState<Record<string, boolean>>({ p2: true });
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-4">
      {products.map(({ id, ...p }) => (
        <ProductCard key={id} {...p} wishlisted={!!liked[id]} onWishlist={(v) => setLiked({ ...liked, [id]: v })} onAdd={() => toast.success('Added to cart', p.name)} />
      ))}
      <p className="w-full text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">Standalone price: <Price amount={2499} compareAt={3299} /></p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Sortable list (`sortable-list`)
Reorder rows by dragging, or with arrow keys on the grip. Controlled, no drag library.
- Group: Display
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add sortable-list`
- Import: `import { SortableList } from '@/components/ui/sortable-list'`

Example:

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { SortableList } from '@/components/ui/sortable-list';

interface Step { id: string; title: string; owner: string; tag: string }

export default function SortableListDemo() {
  const [steps, setSteps] = React.useState<Step[]>([
    { id: 'a', title: 'Collect documents', owner: 'Isha Nair', tag: 'HR' },
    { id: 'b', title: 'Create email and accounts', owner: 'Rohan Das', tag: 'IT' },
    { id: 'c', title: 'Assign a buddy', owner: 'Aarav Mehta', tag: 'Team' },
    { id: 'd', title: 'Schedule day-one orientation', owner: 'Meera Iyer', tag: 'HR' },
    { id: 'e', title: 'Order laptop', owner: 'Vikram Joshi', tag: 'IT' },
  ]);
  return (
    <div className="grid w-full max-w-md gap-2">
      <SortableList items={steps} onChange={setSteps} renderItem={(s, i) => (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="w-4 text-xs tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">{i + 1}</span>
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1"><p className="truncate font-medium">{s.title}</p><p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{s.owner}</p></div>
          <Badge>{s.tag}</Badge>
        </div>
      )} />
      <p className="px-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Drag a row, or Tab to a grip and press the up and down arrows.</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Swipe actions (`swipe-actions`)
List row you swipe left to reveal action buttons. Touch, mouse drag and keyboard.
- Group: Display
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add swipe-actions`
- Import: `import { SwipeActions } from '@/components/ui/swipe-actions'`

Example:

```tsx
import { ArchiveIcon, StarIcon, TrashIcon } from '@/components/ui/icons';
import { Avatar } from '@/components/ui/avatar';
import { SwipeActions } from '@/components/ui/swipe-actions';
import { toast } from '@/components/ui/toast';

const mails = [
  { name: 'Diya Rao', subject: 'Offer letter for Kabir', preview: 'Sent it this morning, joining is 3 Nov.' },
  { name: 'Finance', subject: 'September payroll is ready', preview: 'Please review and approve before Friday.' },
  { name: 'Rohan Das', subject: 'Laptop request', preview: 'Need a 16 GB machine for the new hire.' },
];

export default function SwipeActionsDemo() {
  return (
    <div className="grid w-full max-w-sm gap-2">
      {mails.map((m) => (
        <SwipeActions
          key={m.subject}
          actions={[
            { label: 'Star', icon: <StarIcon />, tone: 'warning', onClick: () => toast.info('Starred', m.subject) },
            { label: 'Archive', icon: <ArchiveIcon />, tone: 'primary', onClick: () => toast.success('Archived', m.subject) },
            { label: 'Delete', icon: <TrashIcon />, tone: 'danger', onClick: () => toast.error('Deleted', m.subject) },
          ]}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3">
            <Avatar name={m.name} />
            <div className="min-w-0"><p className="truncate text-[13px] font-medium">{m.subject}</p><p className="truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{m.name} · {m.preview}</p></div>
          </div>
        </SwipeActions>
      ))}
      <p className="px-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">Swipe or drag a row left. Keyboard: focus a row, press Left.</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Table (`table`)
Dense table parts with hover rows, a selected state, footer and caption.

Example:

```tsx
import { Avatar } from '@/components/ui/avatar';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';

const rows = [
  { id: 'INV-204', client: 'Northwind Traders', owner: 'Aarav Mehta', due: '12 Oct', paid: 100, amount: 4200, status: 'Paid' },
  { id: 'INV-205', client: 'Globex Corp', owner: 'Diya Rao', due: '18 Oct', paid: 40, amount: 1150, status: 'Due' },
  { id: 'INV-206', client: 'Initech', owner: 'Rohan Das', due: '02 Oct', paid: 0, amount: 8900, status: 'Overdue' },
  { id: 'INV-207', client: 'Umbrella Labs', owner: 'Isha Nair', due: '24 Oct', paid: 100, amount: 3275, status: 'Paid' },
  { id: 'INV-208', client: 'Stark Industries', owner: 'Kabir Shah', due: '28 Oct', paid: 65, amount: 12400, status: 'Due' },
  { id: 'INV-209', client: 'Wayne Enterprises', owner: 'Meera Iyer', due: '29 Sep', paid: 0, amount: 6050, status: 'Overdue' },
  { id: 'INV-210', client: 'Hooli', owner: 'Vikram Joshi', due: '05 Nov', paid: 100, amount: 2380, status: 'Paid' },
  { id: 'INV-211', client: 'Soylent Co', owner: 'Aarav Mehta', due: '09 Nov', paid: 15, amount: 5120, status: 'Due' },
];
const tone = { Paid: 'success', Due: 'warning', Overdue: 'danger' } as const;
const usd = (n: number) => `$${n.toLocaleString('en-US')}`;
const total = rows.reduce((s, r) => s + r.amount, 0);
const outstanding = rows.reduce((s, r) => s + r.amount * (1 - r.paid / 100), 0);

export default function TableDemo() {
  return (
    <Card className="w-full max-w-3xl overflow-hidden">
      <Table>
        <TableHeader>
          <TableRow className="hover:bg-transparent">
            <TableHead>Invoice</TableHead>
            <TableHead>Client</TableHead>
            <TableHead>Owner</TableHead>
            <TableHead>Due</TableHead>
            <TableHead className="w-32">Collected</TableHead>
            <TableHead className="text-right">Amount</TableHead>
            <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
          </TableRow>
        </TableHeader>
        <TableBody>
          {rows.map((r) => (
            <TableRow key={r.id}>
              <TableCell className="whitespace-nowrap font-mono text-xs">{r.id}</TableCell>
              <TableCell className="whitespace-nowrap font-medium">{r.client}</TableCell>
              <TableCell><span className="flex items-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap text-muted-foreground"><Avatar name={r.owner} size="sm" />{r.owner}</span></TableCell>
              <TableCell className="whitespace-nowrap text-muted-foreground">{r.due}</TableCell>
              <TableCell><Progress value={r.paid} aria-label={`${r.client} paid`} className="h-1.5" /></TableCell>
              <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">{usd(r.amount)}</TableCell>
              <TableCell><Badge variant={tone[r.status as keyof typeof tone]} dot>{r.status}</Badge></TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          ))}
        </TableBody>
        <TableFooter>
          <TableRow className="hover:bg-transparent">
            <TableCell colSpan={5}>Total · {usd(Math.round(outstanding))} outstanding</TableCell>
            <TableCell className="text-right tabular-nums">{usd(total)}</TableCell>
            <TableCell />
          </TableRow>
        </TableFooter>
        <TableCaption>October billing run, {rows.length} invoices</TableCaption>
      </Table>
    </Card>
  );
}
```

## Area chart (`area-chart`)
Smooth gradient areas, stacked or overlapping, that wipe in on scroll. Hover for a readout across series.
- Group: Data
- What it shows: A line chart with the space under it filled in, so the total amount feels like volume. Stacked, it also shows what each part adds.
- How to read it: Stacked: the top edge is the total, each colored band is one part, and a band getting thicker means that part grew. Overlap mode compares series that each start at zero.
- Use it for: Traffic by source, revenue by plan, any total made of parts that changes over time.
- Skip it when: Many series (more than four bands get unreadable), or when you must compare the exact size of a middle band: its baseline moves, so use lines.
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add area-chart`
- Import: `import { smoothPath, AreaChart } from '@/components/ui/area-chart'`
- Also needs: charts

Example:

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { AreaChart } from '@/components/ui/area-chart';
import { Segmented } from '@/components/ui/segmented';

export default function AreaChartDemo() {
  const [mode, setMode] = React.useState<'stacked' | 'overlap'>('stacked');
  return (
    <div className="grid w-full max-w-xl gap-4">
      <Segmented value={mode} onValueChange={setMode} options={[{ value: 'stacked', label: 'Stacked' }, { value: 'overlap', label: 'Overlap' }]} className="justify-self-start" />
      <AreaChart
        stacked={mode === 'stacked'}
        labels={['Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct']}
        format={(n) => `${n}K`}
        series={[
          { name: 'Organic', data: [12, 14, 13, 18, 21, 24, 27] },
          { name: 'Paid', data: [6, 8, 9, 10, 12, 11, 14] },
          { name: 'Referral', data: [3, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9] },
        ]}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Bar list (`bar-list`)
Ranked list with a bar behind each row: top pages, products, sources, countries.
- Group: Data
- What it shows: A ranked list with a bar behind each name.
- How to read it: The longer the bar behind a row, the bigger its value, scaled to the biggest row. The number is on the right.
- Use it for: Top pages, top products, sources, countries.
- Skip it when: Time series, or when you need more than one number per row.
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add bar-list`
- Import: `import { BarList } from '@/components/ui/bar-list'`

## Box plot chart (`box-plot-chart`)
Spread per group: box for the middle half, median line, whiskers and outlier dots. Boxes open from the median; hover for the five numbers.
- Group: Data
- What it shows: The spread of values in each group, in five numbers: lowest, lower quarter, median, upper quarter, highest.
- How to read it: The line in the box is the median (the typical value). The box covers the middle half of the data. The whiskers reach the lowest and highest normal values. Dots are outliers. A tall box means the values vary a lot.
- Use it for: Response time per endpoint, salary per level, delivery days per carrier.
- Skip it when: Audiences who do not know statistics (add a short caption), or very small groups of fewer than 5 values.
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add box-plot-chart`
- Import: `import { BoxPlotChart } from '@/components/ui/box-plot-chart'`
- Also needs: charts

Example:

```tsx
import { BoxPlotChart } from '@/components/ui/box-plot-chart';

export default function BoxPlotChartDemo() {
  return (
    <BoxPlotChart
      className="w-[36rem] max-w-full"
      format={(n) => `${n}ms`}
      groups={[
        { label: '/login', min: 40, q1: 70, median: 95, q3: 130, max: 190, outliers: [260, 310] },
        { label: '/search', min: 90, q1: 140, median: 210, q3: 320, max: 480, outliers: [620] },
        { label: '/orders', min: 60, q1: 110, median: 150, q3: 190, max: 260 },
        { label: '/export', min: 300, q1: 520, median: 740, q3: 980, max: 1400, outliers: [1750] },
        { label: '/health', min: 8, q1: 12, median: 15, q3: 19, max: 28 },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

## Bullet chart (`bullet-chart`)
A KPI against its target in one thin row, with shaded bands for poor, ok and good. The bar slides in on scroll.
- Group: Data
- What it shows: One measure against its target, in a single thin row. It replaces a gauge and uses less space.
- How to read it: The dark or colored bar is the actual value. The vertical tick is the target. The shaded bands behind are poor, okay and good ranges. A bar that passes the tick beat the target.
- Use it for: KPIs vs goals: revenue vs quota, uptime vs SLA, NPS vs target.
- Skip it when: A single number with no target or range: use a stat card.
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add bullet-chart`
- Import: `import { BulletChart } from '@/components/ui/bullet-chart'`
- Also needs: charts

Example:

```tsx
import { BulletChart } from '@/components/ui/bullet-chart';

export default function BulletChartDemo() {
  return (
    <BulletChart
      className="w-[34rem] max-w-full"
      rows={[
        { label: 'Revenue (₹L)', value: 72, target: 66, ranges: [40, 60, 90] },
        { label: 'New customers', value: 118, target: 150, ranges: [80, 120, 180] },
        { label: 'Uptime (%)', value: 99.94, target: 99.9, ranges: [99, 99.5, 100] },
        { label: 'NPS', value: 41, target: 50, ranges: [20, 40, 70] },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

## Bump chart (`bump-chart`)
Rank over time as smooth lines that swap places. Lines draw in one by one; hover a line or name to follow it.
- Group: Data
- What it shows: How rank changes over time. Not the values, only the order.
- How to read it: Each line is one item. Numbers in the dots are ranks, with 1 at the top. A line moving up means the item climbed. Crossing lines swapped places.
- Use it for: Leaderboards by month, search position, product popularity, league tables.
- Skip it when: When the gap between ranks matters (first can be far ahead of second): use a line chart of the values.
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add bump-chart`
- Import: `import { BumpChart } from '@/components/ui/bump-chart'`
- Also needs: charts

Example:

```tsx
import { BumpChart } from '@/components/ui/bump-chart';

  return (
    <BumpChart
      className="w-[38rem] max-w-full"
      labels={['Jun', 'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct']}
      series={[
        { name: 'Pune', ranks: [1, 1, 2, 3, 2] },
        { name: 'Mumbai', ranks: [2, 3, 1, 1, 1] },
        { name: 'Delhi', ranks: [3, 2, 3, 2, 3] },
        { name: 'Bengaluru', ranks: [4, 4, 4, 4, 4] },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

## Butterfly chart (`butterfly-chart`)
Two bar sets back to back around shared rows, like a population pyramid. Bars grow outward from the middle.
- Group: Data
- What it shows: Two sets of bars back to back around a shared list. Also called a population pyramid.
- How to read it: The center column names each row. Bars to the left belong to the left group, bars to the right to the right group. Longer is more. Compare the two sides row by row.
- Use it for: Population by age and gender, desktop vs mobile per page, hires and exits per team.
- Skip it when: Groups that are not comparable, or a single group. Use a bar chart.
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add butterfly-chart`
- Import: `import { ButterflyChart } from '@/components/ui/butterfly-chart'`
- Also needs: charts

Example:

```tsx
import { ButterflyChart } from '@/components/ui/butterfly-chart';

export default function ButterflyChartDemo() {
  return (
    <ButterflyChart
      className="w-[36rem] max-w-full"
      leftLabel="Mobile"
      rightLabel="Desktop"
      rows={[
        { label: 'Home', left: 5200, right: 3100 }, { label: 'Pricing', left: 3400, right: 4200 }, { label: 'Docs', left: 1800, right: 5600 },
        { label: 'Blog', left: 4100, right: 2300 }, { label: 'Signup', left: 2600, right: 2900 }, { label: 'Settings', left: 700, right: 1900 },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

## Candlestick chart (`candlestick-chart`)
Open, high, low and close per period. Green closed up, red closed down. Candles grow from their midpoint in sequence; hover for the four numbers.
- Group: Data
- What it shows: Open, high, low and close for each period, used for prices.
- How to read it: The thick body runs from the open to the close. Green means the close was higher than the open, red means lower. The thin line (the wick) reaches the highest and lowest value in the period.
- Use it for: Share prices, currency rates, any value with a daily range.
- Skip it when: Data with only one value per period: use a line chart.
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add candlestick-chart`
- Import: `import { CandlestickChart } from '@/components/ui/candlestick-chart'`
- Also needs: charts

Example:

```tsx
import { CandlestickChart, type Candle } from '@/components/ui/candlestick-chart';

// Deterministic walk so the demo looks the same every time.
const rnd = (i: number) => { const x = Math.sin(i * 12.9898) * 43758.5453; return x - Math.floor(x); };
const data: Candle[] = (() => {
  let price = 100;
  return Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => {
    const open = price;
    const close = open + (rnd(i) - 0.45) * 8;
    price = close;
    return { label: `D${i + 1}`, open, close, high: Math.max(open, close) + rnd(i + 50) * 3, low: Math.min(open, close) - rnd(i + 90) * 3 };
  });
})();

export default function CandlestickChartDemo() {
  return <CandlestickChart className="w-full max-w-xl" data={data} />;
}
```

## Charts (`charts`)
Sparkline, bar chart and donut in plain SVG. No chart library.
- Group: Data
- What it shows: Three small charts: a sparkline (a tiny trend line), a bar chart, and a donut (share of a whole).
- How to read it: Sparkline: only the shape matters, left is older, right is newer. Bars: taller means more. Donut: a bigger slice means a bigger share, and the slices add up to 100%.
- Use it for: Sparkline inside a stat card, bars to compare a few categories, donut for a split like plan mix.
- Skip it when: Donut with more than five or six slices, or when you need exact numbers: use a table or bar list instead.
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add charts`
- Import: `import { useChartIn, Sparkline, BarChart, DonutChart } from '@/components/ui/charts'`

Example:

```tsx
import { BarChart, DonutChart, Sparkline } from '@/components/ui/charts';
import { Card } from '@/components/ui/card';

export default function ChartsDemo() {
  return (
    <div className="grid w-full gap-4 lg:grid-cols-2">
      <Card className="p-5">
        <p className="mb-4 text-sm font-semibold">Leads per month</p>
        <BarChart data={[{ label: 'May', value: 38 }, { label: 'Jun', value: 52 }, { label: 'Jul', value: 47 }, { label: 'Aug', value: 66 }, { label: 'Sep', value: 59 }, { label: 'Oct', value: 81 }]} />
      </Card>
      <Card className="grid gap-5 p-5">
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold">Lead source</p>
        <DonutChart
          centerLabel={<div><p className="text-xl font-semibold leading-none">342</p><p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">leads</p></div>}
          data={[{ label: 'Website', value: 140 }, { label: 'Referral', value: 90 }, { label: 'Events', value: 70 }, { label: 'Cold outreach', value: 42 }]}
        />
        <div className="h-10 w-40"><Sparkline data={[4, 6, 5, 8, 7, 10, 9, 13]} /></div>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Chord chart (`chord-chart`)
Flow between every pair of items around a circle. Arcs sweep in, then ribbons fade in; hover an item to keep only its ribbons.
- Group: Data
- What it shows: How much flows between every pair of items, drawn around a circle.
- How to read it: Each arc on the ring is one item. A ribbon joining two arcs is the flow between them. A wider ribbon is more flow. Hover an item to keep only its ribbons.
- Use it for: Migration between cities, messages between teams, trades between desks.
- Skip it when: More than about 10 items (it turns into a tangle), or when direction matters a lot. A sankey shows direction better.
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add chord-chart`
- Import: `import { ChordChart } from '@/components/ui/chord-chart'`
- Also needs: charts

Example:

```tsx
import { ChordChart } from '@/components/ui/chord-chart';

export default function ChordChartDemo() {
  return (
    <ChordChart
      size={340}
      labels={['Pune', 'Mumbai', 'Delhi', 'Bengaluru', 'Chennai']}
      matrix={[
        [0, 120, 40, 60, 20],
        [110, 0, 70, 50, 30],
        [30, 80, 0, 90, 25],
        [70, 40, 100, 0, 85],
        [15, 35, 20, 95, 0],
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

## Circle pack chart (`circle-pack-chart`)
One bubble per item, area by value, packed into a cluster. Bubbles pop out from the center biggest first; hover for the share.
- Group: Data
- What it shows: Bubbles packed together, one per item, where the area of each bubble is its value.
- How to read it: A bigger bubble is a bigger value. Biggest sits in the middle. Compare areas, not widths. Hover a bubble for its exact share.
- Use it for: Users by country, revenue by customer, tags by use: lots of items with a few giants and a long tail.
- Skip it when: Close values (people misjudge circle area) and anything that needs an order. A lollipop or bar chart ranks better.
- Add: `npx github:RandomKid24/befui add circle-pack-chart`
- Import: `import { CirclePackChart } from '@/components/ui/circle-pack-chart'`
- Also needs: charts

Example:

```tsx

export default function CirclePackChartDemo() {
  return (
    <CirclePackChart
      className="w-[34rem] max-w-full"
      items={[
        { label: 'India', value: 4200 }, { label: 'USA', value: 2600 }, { label: 'UAE', value: 1500 }, { label: 'UK', value: 1200 },
        { label: 'Germany', value: 800 }, { label: 'Singapore', value: 700 }, { label: 'Canada', value: 520 }, { label: 'Brazil', value: 380 },
        { label: 'Japan', value: 300 }, { label: 'Kenya', value: 160 }, { label: 'Chile', value: 90 },
      ]}
    />
  );
}
```

## Data table (`data-table`)
Sortable columns, a search box and pagination, with optional row selection and bulk actions, column visibility menu, sticky header, toolbar slot, row action menus and clickable rows. You pass rows and column definitions.

Example:

```tsx

import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { DataTable, type Column } from '@/components/ui/data-table';
import { TooltipProvider, TruncatedText } from '@/components/ui/tooltip';

interface Person { id: string; name: string; email: string; team: string; city: string; joined: string; salary: number; status: 'Active' | 'On leave' | 'Notice' }

const people: Person[] = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Aarav Mehta', email: 'aarav.mehta@acme.in', team: 'Engineering', city: 'Pune', joined: '2021-03-15', salary: 1850000, status: 'Active' },

  { id: '5', name: 'Kabir Shah', email: 'kabir.shah@acme.in', team: 'Engineering', city: 'Ahmedabad', joined: '2019-05-06', salary: 2250000, status: 'Notice' },
  { id: '6', name: 'Meera Iyer', email: 'meera.iyer@acme.in', team: 'Finance', city: 'Chennai', joined: '2022-02-14', salary: 1380000, status: 'Active' },
  { id: '7', name: 'Vikram Joshi', email: 'vikram.joshi@acme.in', team: 'Sales', city: 'Nashik', joined: '2023-08-21', salary: 880000, status: 'Active' },
  { id: '8', name: 'Ananya Kulkarni', email: 'ananya.kulkarni@acme.in', team: 'Engineering', city: 'Pune', joined: '2024-01-08', salary: 1620000, status: 'Active' },
  { id: '9', name: 'Siddharth Verma', email: 'siddharth.verma@acme.in', team: 'Support', city: 'Delhi', joined: '2021-09-30', salary: 720000, status: 'On leave' },
  { id: '10', name: 'Tara Menon', email: 'tara.menon@acme.in', team: 'Design', city: 'Bengaluru', joined: '2023-04-17', salary: 1290000, status: 'Active' },
  { id: '11', name: 'Nikhil Patil', email: 'nikhil.patil@acme.in', team: 'Finance', city: 'Nagpur', joined: '2020-06-02', salary: 1540000, status: 'Active' },
  { id: '12', name: 'Pooja Desai', email: 'pooja.desai@acme.in', team: 'People Ops', city: 'Surat', joined: '2024-05-13', salary: 940000, status: 'Notice' },

const tone = { Active: 'success', 'On leave': 'warning', Notice: 'danger' } as const;
const date = (d: string) => new Date(d).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' });

const columns: Column<Person>[] = [
  { key: 'name', header: 'Name', sortable: true, value: (p) => p.name, render: (p) => <span className="flex items-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap"><Avatar name={p.name} size="sm" />{p.name}</span> },
  { key: 'email', header: 'Email', value: (p) => p.email, render: (p) => <TruncatedText className="w-36 text-muted-foreground">{p.email}</TruncatedText> },
  { key: 'team', header: 'Team', sortable: true, value: (p) => p.team },
  { key: 'joined', header: 'Joined', sortable: true, value: (p) => p.joined, render: (p) => <span className="whitespace-nowrap text-muted-foreground">{date(p.joined)}</span> },
  { key: 'salary', header: 'Salary', sortable: true, align: 'right', value: (p) => p.salary, render: (p) => `₹${(p.salary / 100000).toFixed(1)}L` },

        filterPlaceholder="Filter people"
        selectable
        columnMenu

          <>
            <Button size="xs" variant="outline" onClick={clear}>Export {rows.length}</Button>
            <Button size="xs" variant="ghost" onClick={clear}>Clear</Button>
          </>
        )}
      />
    </TooltipProvider>
  );
}
```
